Camila, can you send Evan this cleaned quote plus two short options (formal and casual) so Brightline's comms can pick? Also copying Olivia Grant at TechWeekly (trade) to gauge interest — Olivia, are you available for embargoed coverage the evening of Mar 15?

- Casual: "Redwood helped us move from stalled prototypes to production-grade inference — the speed and cost improvements were a game-changer."
